questions.question: Dr. Mamouni hesitates between sole proprietorship and LLC. His personal assets are significant. Dr. Ibrahimi advises him to choose the LLC. According to Law 5-96, what is the main advantage of the LLC for asset protection?
options: Liability is limited to 50% of contributions
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'In an LLC, your liability is limited to your contributions. Your personal assets are protected.' Dr. Mamouni: 'That's reassuring, I will create an LLC.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi practices as a natural person with a turnover of 900,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni advises him to create an LLC. According to the GTC, what is the main tax advantage of the LLC on this profit bracket?
options: CIT at 10% on the 0-300,000 DH bracket vs progressive PIT
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'CIT is more advantageous than PIT for high profits. On 300,000 DH, CIT is 30,000 DH vs about 65,000 DH in PIT.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will create an LLC.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni wishes to associate with 3 colleagues. Dr. Ibrahimi advises him to choose an LLC. According to Law 5-96, what is the maximum number of partners in a standard LLC?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The standard LLC can accommodate 2 to 50 partners. You are 4, that's perfect.' Dr. Mamouni: 'The LLC is the ideal structure for us.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, the sole partner of a single-member LLC, wishes to know the creation formalities. Dr. Mamouni reminds him of the obligations. According to Law 5-96, must the single-member LLC have articles of association?
options: No, the sole partner can decide alone
Yes, but only for standard LLCs
No, a simple private deed is sufficient
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'Articles are mandatory for any LLC, including the single-member LLC. They set the operating rules.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will have articles drafted.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, as a natural person, has a dispute with a supplier. Dr. Ibrahimi warns him of the risks. Under Moroccan law, as a natural person, who is liable for professional debts?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'As a natural person, there is confusion of assets. Your personal assets can be seized.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will create an LLC to protect myself.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi has an LLC with a capital of 10,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni asks him if the capital can be increased. According to Law 5-96, is a capital increase possible?
options: Yes, by decision of the partners
Yes, but only in the first 3 years
No, except in the event of dissolution
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'A capital increase is possible by a collective decision of the partners.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I can increase the capital if necessary.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, manager of an LLC, wishes to commit the company to an important contract. Dr. Ibrahimi reminds him of the rules. According to Article 63 of Law 5-96, what are the manager's powers?
options: He can only commit the company for acts authorized by the articles
He commits the company through acts falling within the corporate purpose
He must obtain the agreement of all partners
He can only commit the company for acts under 50,000 DH
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The manager commits the company through acts falling within the corporate purpose. Statutory clauses limiting his powers are unenforceable against third parties.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I can therefore sign this contract.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi wishes to withdraw from the LLC. Dr. Mamouni informs him about the transfer of shares. According to Law 5-96, is the transfer of shares free?
options: No, it is subject to approval if the articles provide for it
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'The transfer of shares may be subject to approval if the articles provide for it. You must check the statutory clauses.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will consult the articles.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, as a natural person, has a turnover of 400,000 DH. Dr. Ibrahimi asks him to check his tax regime. According to the GTC, which regime is he subject to?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'For liberal professions, RNS applies to natural persons whose turnover is between 250,000 and 500,000 DH.' Dr. Mamouni: 'So I am under RNS.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, manager of an LLC, wants to borrow from his company. Dr. Mamouni warns him of the prohibitions. According to Article 66 of Law 5-96, is this permitted?
options: Yes, for an amount under 50,000 DH
Yes, if the loan is for the practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'Article 66 prohibits managers from borrowing from the company, in any form whatsoever.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will not make this loan.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni has an LLC with 5 partners. Dr. Ibrahimi asks him how decisions are made. According to Law 5-96, which decisions require unanimity?
options: None, decisions are taken by majority
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'In an LLC, decisions are taken by majority of partners, unless the articles provide for a reinforced majority.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will check our articles.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, as a natural person, wishes to create a single-member LLC. Dr. Mamouni informs him about the formalities. According to Law 5-96, is the single-member LLC subject to the same obligations as a standard LLC?
options: Yes, it is subject to the same obligations
No, it is exempt from certain formalities
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'The single-member LLC is subject to the same obligations as a standard LLC, except that general meetings are replaced by decisions of the sole partner.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'That's a good option.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, manager of an LLC, wishes to create a branch. Dr. Ibrahimi asks him if this is possible. According to Law 5-96, can the manager create a branch without partners' authorization?
options: No, a collective decision is required
Yes, it is an ordinary management act
Yes, but only if the articles allow it
No, creating a branch is prohibited
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'Creating a branch is an ordinary management act within the manager's powers.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will create this branch.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi has an LLC with a profit of 400,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni helps him calculate the CIT. According to the 2026 scale, what is the amount of CIT due?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'CIT is calculated by brackets: 300,000 × 10% = 30,000 DH, 100,000 × 20% = 20,000 DH. Total = 50,000 DH.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will plan for this amount.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, the sole partner of a single-member LLC, dies. Dr. Ibrahimi informs him about the heirs' rights. According to the 2024 amendments, how many days do the heirs have to request the appointment of a representative?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The 2024 amendments provide a 60-day period to request the appointment of a representative.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will inform my heirs of this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, as a natural person, has a tax deficit of 60,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni reminds him of the carry-forward rules. Under RNR, over how many years can he carry forward this deficit?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'Under RNR, the deficit can be carried forward against profits of the following four years.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will track this carry-forward.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, manager of an LLC, wishes to be remunerated. Dr. Ibrahimi asks him how his remuneration is determined. According to Law 5-96, the manager's remuneration is determined by:
options: An ordinary collective decision of the partners
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'Managers' remuneration is determined by an ordinary collective decision of the partners.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will propose my remuneration to the partners.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, as a natural person, has a turnover of 1,200,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni advises him to create an LLC. What is the main disadvantage of being a natural person for a high turnover?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'The main disadvantage of being a natural person is the progressive PIT rate which can reach 37%.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will create an LLC to optimize.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, a partner in an LLC, wishes to sell his shares. Dr. Ibrahimi reminds him of the rules. According to Law 5-96, is the transfer of shares to a third party subject to approval?
options: Yes, if the articles provide for an approval clause
No, unless the transfer is under 50,000 DH
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The transfer of shares may be subject to approval if the articles provide for it. You must consult the articles.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will check our articles.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi has an LLC with a capital of 100,000 DH. Dr. Mamouni asks him if the capital can be reduced. According to Law 5-96, is a capital reduction possible?
options: Yes, by decision of the partners
Yes, but only in the event of losses
No, except in the event of dissolution
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'A capital reduction is possible by decision of the partners, particularly in the event of losses.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I can reduce the capital if necessary.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, manager of an LLC, has a conflict with a partner. Dr. Ibrahimi advises him to consult the articles. According to Law 5-96, can the articles provide for conflict resolution clauses?
options: No, the law does not allow it
Yes, the articles can provide for resolution clauses
Yes, but only for single-member LLCs
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The articles can provide for clauses for resolving conflicts between partners.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will consult our articles.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi, as a natural person, wishes to hire his first employee. Dr. Mamouni reminds him of the obligations. According to the Labor Code, what are the mandatory declarations?
options: Declaration to CNSS, AMO and CNOPS
Declaration to the Ministry of Labor
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'The employer must declare his employee to CNSS (social insurance) and AMO (health insurance).' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will make the necessary declarations.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, the sole partner of a single-member LLC, wishes to dissolve his company. Dr. Ibrahimi informs him about the procedure. According to Law 5-96, can the sole partner dissolve the company alone?
options: Yes, he can decide alone on dissolution
Yes, but only after 5 years of activity
No, a general meeting is required
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'The sole partner exercises the powers conferred on all partners. He can therefore decide alone on dissolution.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I can therefore dissolve whenever I want.'

questions.question: Dr. Ibrahimi has an LLC with 3 partners. Dr. Mamouni asks him how extraordinary decisions are taken. According to Law 5-96, what quorum is required for extraordinary decisions?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mamouni explains: 'Extraordinary decisions (amendment of articles, dissolution) require a quorum of three-quarters of the votes.' Dr. Ibrahimi: 'I will check our articles.'

questions.question: Dr. Mamouni, after choosing the LLC with Dr. Ibrahimi, receives his congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Mamouni?
options: Become an expert in dental legal strategy
questions.explanation: Dr. Ibrahimi explains: 'Mastery of legal forms is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert in legal strategy is the next step.' Dr. Mamouni: 'I will train in company law.'
